  • eSIM compatibility: Works with all eSIM-compatible devices.

If you only need a data plan, you can call through apps (VoIP), such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, and Facebook Messenger.

  • Speed: 3G/4G/LTE/5G, depending on local network providers.

  • Hotspot: No hotspot restrictions or limitations.

  • Coverage: Enjoy reliable internet access in various cities across South Korea, such as Seoul, Busan, and Incheon. Please note that coverage quality will depend on local network providers.

  • Network: The Saily eSIM service connects to the best local network carriers to offer the most stable and reliable connection to the internet.

  • Plan top-up: Easily top up with more GBs in the app when you’re running low — your new data plan will automatically activate once your first plan completely runs out. Choose the auto top-up option for an even more seamless experience.

  • Security: Enjoy safer browsing with built-in security features like virtual location, ad blocker, and web protection against malicious sites and trackers.

Frequently asked questions about eSIMs for South Korea

Yes, an eSIM will work on these devices if they support the eSIM functionality. Not sure? See our list of eSIM-supported devices.

The best eSIM data plan for South Korea depends on your travel plans, data needs, and how long you’ll be staying. If you’re just visiting for a few days and only need data for maps, messaging, and some light browsing, a smaller plan like 1 GB for 7 days might be enough. But if you plan to stream videos, use social media frequently, or stay longer, a larger plan — like 5 GB or even 10 GB — will ensure you stay connected without worrying about running out of data.
Saily offers a range of prepaid eSIM data plans for South Korea, so you can pick one that best fits your needs. Before choosing, consider how often you'll be using mobile data, whether you’ll have access to Wi-Fi, and if you need a backup option in case of emergencies.

Yes! If you’re planning to visit South Korea, we offer multiple data plans for you to choose from.

No. South Korean eSIM data is designed to work within South Korea, so it won’t provide coverage in Japan. For multi-country trips, consider getting a Global eSIM or an Asia & Oceania eSIM, which covers multiple destinations, including both South Korea and Japan. Alternatively, you can purchase an eSIM for Japan for local coverage when you arrive.

The cost of eSIM plans in South Korea varies depending on the data allowance and validity period. Saily offers competitive pricing for its eSIM plans for South Korea. For instance, a 5 GB plan valid for 30 days costs US$10.99.

You have two options for getting an eSIM — buying it online through a website or purchasing it directly from an app. If you want to set everything up before your trip, you can buy an eSIM online with just a few clicks. Choose your preferred Saily data plan, complete the purchase, and follow the activation instructions. Your Saily eSIM will be ready to use as soon as you arrive. You can also get an eSIM through the app. Download the app, browse available plans, make your selection, and install your eSIM instantly.

Using the Saily eSIM app in South Korea is simple. Pick an eSIM data plan and purchase it, then download the Saily eSIM app and follow the steps on the screen. When you arrive in South Korea, your eSIM will activate automatically. That’s it! You’re all set to browse, navigate, and stay connected without worrying about roaming fees.

Once you purchase an eSIM plan, you’ll get a QR code via email — just scan it, follow a few quick setup steps, and you’re good to go. Your eSIM will activate automatically when you arrive in South Korea (as long as you’ve turned on your eSIM in your phone’s settings and enabled roaming).
With an eSIM, you’re not tied to just one network. A travel eSIM lets your device connect to multiple providers, so you get the best possible coverage wherever you go. Since it’s prepaid, there are no contracts or surprise fees — just a set amount of data for the duration of your trip.

Yes, using the Saily eSIM app is absolutely safe wherever you are. And to make your digital life even safer, we’ve added special security features. You can use them to get a new virtual location, reduce online trackers, and block malicious ads.

If your eSIM is not working, you can try a few things to get it back on track:

  1. 1.

    Check your device’s compatibility — see our list of eSIM-supported devices.

  2. 2.

    Restart your phone — as with most technical issues, restarting is the first thing you should do.

  3. 3.

    Check the network settings on your device — make sure your eSIM profile is turned on and roaming is activated.

Visit our blog post for more information if your eSIM is still not working.

Open the Saily eSIM app, go to phone numbers, and pick a US number. Pair it with a plan for calls and text messages so you can use it as your second phone number. It activates in one tap after a quick identity verification. You can use it alongside any Saily eSIM data plan for travel, sign-ups, and everyday communication.
